  "evidence": "The unique_fct_orders_order_key test failed with 12,900 duplicate order_key rows. In fct_orders, the CTE 'items' grouped by order_key and line_number, producing multiple rows per order_key (one per line item). The subsequent left join on order_key duplicated order rows, violating uniqueness. Removing line_number from the GROUP BY (and not selecting it) aggregates items per order, eliminating duplicates. After applying the patch, all tests pass."
}

args.evidence: The unique_fct_orders_order_key test failed with 12,900 duplicate order_key rows. In fct_orders, the CTE 'items' grouped by order_key and line_number, producing multiple rows per order_key (one per line item). The subsequent left join on order_key duplicated order rows, violating uniqueness. Removing line_number from the GROUP BY (and not selecting it) aggregates items per order, eliminating duplicates. After applying the patch, all tests pass.
